content.comment_body: I am working with block diagrams on the [product_name] programming platform. When using the 'mathematical instructions' block, reference fields for V1...V4 are available only with the older [product_name] hardware. This is outdated compared to the latest device, yet the expected reference fields are missing in the newer model. Could someone explain what has changed or what I might be overlooking?

Parameter referencing in [product_name] with [article_no] works differently. You can find more details by checking this FAQ: How can references between blocks be configured in the latest version of [product_name]?
Welcome! As time passes, the referencing method was altered when the newer [product_name] model was released back in 2014. But don't worry, that was only 11 years ago.
Thank you! I'm new to this platform, but your advice has made things clearer for me.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have observed that reference fields (V1...V4) available in older versions of [product_name] programming software and hardware are missing in the latest models, causing confusion for those used to the previous functionality. This has raised concerns about consistency across versions and the discoverability of features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect newer [product_name] hardware and configuration platforms to maintain or improve upon the reference field functionality found in previous generations, with a focus on backward compatibility and continued feature availability.
